hero_claim.headline_en: Visibly Brightens and Evens Skin Tone with Tranexamic Acid & Niacinamide
hero_claim.headline_kr: 트라넥삼산과 나이아신아마이드로 맑고 균일한 피부톤을 선사합니다
hero_claim.scientific_basis_en: Tranexamic acid and niacinamide are scientifically recognized for their ability to address hyperpigmentation by targeting melanin production and transfer. Studies highlight their synergistic effects in improving skin tone and reducing dark spots. (PMID: 41832625, 42152519, 41537948)
hero_claim.scientific_basis_kr: 트라넥삼산과 나이아신아마이드는 멜라닌 생성 및 이동을 조절하여 색소침착 개선에 효과적인 성분으로 과학적으로 입증되었습니다. 연구들은 피부톤 개선 및 잡티 감소에 대한 이들의 시너지 효과를 강조합니다. (PMID: 41832625, 42152519, 41537948)

rtb_points.point_en: Helps inhibit melanin synthesis and transfer to reduce the appearance of dark spots.
rtb_points.point_kr: 멜라닌 생성 및 이동을 억제하여 색소침착 개선에 도움을 줍니다.
rtb_points.evidence: PMID: 41832625 | Microneedle-based Transdermal Patch: A Novel Strategy for Hyperpigmentation Treatment.

rtb_points.point_en: Supports a brighter, more even skin tone by addressing various pigmentation concerns.
rtb_points.point_kr: 다양한 색소침착 고민을 케어하여 더욱 맑고 균일한 피부톤을 가꾸는 데 도움을 줍니다.
rtb_points.evidence: PMID: 42152519 | Multitargeted Modulation of Skin Dullness by HNHT Formulation: Synergistic Inhibition of Melanogenesis, Glycation, and L

rtb_points.point_en: Contributes to improved skin radiance and clarity.
rtb_points.evidence: PMID: 41537948 | Egyptian National Consensus on Dermocosmetic Ingredient Selection Across Common Dermatology Scenarios: A RAND/UCLA Appro

rtb_points.point_en: Tranexamic acid shows potential in protecting dermal fibroblasts from senescence, contributing to overall skin health.
rtb_points.point_kr: 트라넥삼산은 진피 섬유아세포의 노화 방지에 잠재력을 보여 전반적인 피부 건강에 기여합니다.
rtb_points.evidence: PMID: 42059427 | Tranexamic acid protects human dermal fibroblasts from D-galactose-induced senescence via the GPR30/MAPK pathway.

tech_story.headline_en: Advanced Formulation for Enhanced Transdermal Delivery
supporting_facts_en: Utilizes advanced delivery systems to ensure optimal penetration of active ingredients.
Formulated to maximize the synergistic benefits of Tranexamic Acid and Niacinamide.
supporting_facts_kr: 유효 성분의 최적 침투를 위한 첨단 전달 시스템을 활용합니다.
트라넥삼산과 나이아신아마이드의 시너지 효과를 극대화하도록 배합되었습니다.

risky_claims_to_avoid_en: Prevents all types of skin discoloration.
claims.north_america_angle_en: Leverages clinically supported ingredients for effective hyperpigmentation management, appealing to a consumer base seeking proven results and advanced skincare solutions.
claims.north_america_angle_kr: 임상적으로 지지받는 성분을 활용하여 효과적인 색소침착 관리를 제공하며, 검증된 결과와 고급 스킨케어 솔루션을 찾는 북미 소비자들에게 어필합니다.
